in_marathi.name: Harikrishna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Hari (God Vishnu) + Krishna (Darkness, Absence of Illusion)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harikrishna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harikrishna is a combination of two powerful Sanskrit words: Hari and Krishna. Hari refers to Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. Krishna refers to the all-pervading darkness or the absence of illusion. Thus, Harikrishna signifies the divine presence that transcends both illusion and reality. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and spirituality.
